name: failure-memory
description: Share evidence-backed failure lessons across agents without saving requirement changes as mistakes.

interface.shortDescription: Remember real failures quickly without saving requirement changes.
interface.longDescription: Uses one native recording call to distinguish real failures from requirement changes, preserve evidence-bounded root causes and proposed repairs, reuse or generalize related lessons safely, and append recall/outcome telemetry. Every local harness shares one owner-private memory.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate whether this correction is a real failure.
Recall relevant lessons before I continue.
